policy.compatibility: The v5 plan permits deliberate web contract changes. Full CSS and root entries remain supported; source-only signals are review prompts, not proof of broken behavior. Consumer data and application ownership remain protected.
policy.versioning: This contract describes Lumen 5 migration behavior. Bundled evidence does not query the registry or establish availability. Publication requires the normal approved GitHub workflow.

changes.currentContract: Web adapters install the umbrella CLI and TypeScript and provide the lumen executable.
changes.replacement: Web adapters depend on runtime packages only; the umbrella package owns the CLI.
changes.migration: Install @santi020k/lumen as a development dependency when scripts or contributors use lumen. Keep runtime adapters in application dependencies.

changes.currentContract: LumenInitUiPrimitives is synchronous and mounting the runtime loads the interactive catalog.
changes.replacement: LumenInitUiPrimitives returns a promise; matching controllers load on demand. ui:ready follows completion and ui:runtime-error reports failed automatic initialization.
changes.migration: Await initialization before relying on newly enhanced markup. Listen for ui:ready or await the function for caller-created markup; handle rejection. LumenToast returns its ID immediately but renders asynchronously. Keep UIPrimitives in the shared Astro layout.

changes.currentContract: The full stylesheet loads the catalog on each page that imports it.
changes.replacement: Astro components import their own styles; React and Elements expose shared foundation and component CSS. Full styles.css remains supported.
changes.migration: Use foundation.css once and documented component CSS for React/Elements; Astro component styles are automatic. Remove full CSS only after checking runtime-created and Markdown markup, navigation, themes and all routes. No source-only audit proves route delivery.

changes.currentContract: Root JavaScript exports and catalog-wide Elements registration remain convenient but can traverse or initialize unrelated modules.
changes.replacement: Documented granular implementations and per-component Elements registrations reduce the dependency graph.
changes.migration: Use the actual exported component entries generated by lumen add. Keep root entries when an equivalent granular export is unavailable. Measure emitted and requested assets separately from traversed modules.

changes.currentContract: Reveals can activate below explicit thresholds or remain hidden when their threshold is unreachable.
changes.replacement: Web reveals honor the requested ratio and stay visible when geometry, reduced motion, or keyboard access makes hiding inappropriate.
changes.migration: Keep explicit thresholds; do not replace every value with zero. Check tall/clipped groups, enlarged text, focus, repeatable reveals and reduced motion. Focused content stays visible for the lifetime of that controller.

changes.currentContract: Consumers may target internal Timeline, ThemeToggle and WorldMap markup.
changes.replacement: Documented data-slot parts and ThemeToggle icon sizing provide matching web customization hooks.
changes.migration: Use the published styling contract and --ui-theme-toggle-icon-size. Compare local overrides with upstream fixes; remove patches only after equivalent consumer tests pass.

changes.currentContract: Applications own repeated video, code, sharing, reading, search and image-viewer compositions.
changes.replacement: Editable recipes compose maintained primitives with explicit dependencies and setup metadata.
changes.migration: Use lumen add to preview/install a recipe. Application code owns content, request adapters, localization and routing. Existing copies are never overwritten without an explicit force option.

changes.currentContract: Source diagnostics cannot prove actual overflow, browser failures or route asset requests.
changes.replacement: lumen audit-rendered explicitly inspects a caller-provided local URL with project-installed Playwright.
changes.migration: Run the app preview yourself, supply a canonical local URL and exact known/allowed asset inventory. Redirects and external requests are blocked and make observation incomplete. Ordinary doctor remains source-only.
